snippet.title: Core Blaster - The Game
snippet.description:
A mind-blowing strategic game that will rock your world. When strategy meets puzzler, you can only imagine how fun and addictive it is! Choose weapons and tactics wisely to crush the hectic hazards before the entire engine explodes! Every second is crucial. Every decision counts! Do not miss this out! Play and experience!
Fan Page : http://www.facebook.com/home.php#!/pages/Core-Blaster/119521658117584
